source.kind: GitHub Actions job logs and artifact metadata
source.artifact_access_note: Raw artifact ZIPs were not downloaded and independently re-audited in this run. The retained artifact digests are GitHub-reported metadata, not locally verified hashes. Logs contain measured public capability identifiers; these do not replace raw ClientHello/PCAP evidence.

baseline_comparison.changes: X448, Ed448, Brainpool signatures and EtM omissions are eliminated. Overall verdict/TLS/TCP/paired counts unchanged. Independent HTTP MATCH changed from 64 to 65 among unstable Go h2 baselines; this is not attributed to an HTTP implementation fix.

retention_definitions.present_in: Number of offering cells also containing the identifier in each measured sample.
retention_definitions.whole_vector_match_cells: Exact ordered equality of the named inbound/outbound capability vector for offering cells. This is not the complete TLS fingerprint.
retention_definitions.zero_offers: Does not establish interoperability. Independent capability tests supply negotiated/negative evidence.

remaining_omissions_scope: Presence-only counts from logged TLS capability vectors; does not enumerate every normalized TLS field or HTTP difference.
